description:
List direct articles, subcategories and files in an RS3 Wiki category. Use search_wiki to discover category titles; get_ge_info (view=categories) lists GE groups instead.

category is a literal Category: title, not a GE number. limit bounds this page of members, not recursion depth. Supply nextCursor unchanged with the same category to continue. You may change limit between pages, but changing categories invalidates the cursor. There is no recursive expansion or snapshot lock, so edits can affect later pages.

An empty set can mean an empty or missing category. Results contain metadata links, never article bodies or images. Reads are uncached and need no credentials. HTTP defaults to 60 requests/IP/minute; honor 429 Retry-After.

category.description: Wiki category title including Category:, e.g. Category:Weapons

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from this category; omit for its first page

name: list_wiki_category_members
title: List Wiki Category Members
